input.goal: Build the wraps: On a tortilla wrap, add shredded lettuce, chopped tomatoes, chopped onion, spicy chicken and creamy hot sauce, then wrap into a burrito shaped roll or whatever shape desired.

sub_goals.text: Open the lettuce bag and take out lettuce
Transfer the chopped onion into a bowl
Prepare the chopping board and weigh a tomato
Remove seeds from the first tomato
Remove seeds from the second tomato

skills.object_recognition: L1: which object is in hand / being handled at the moment of the event
skills.spatial_near: L1: at the moment of the event, which of the listed objects is nearest to a reference object (3D positions from the dataset)
skills.spatial_side: L1: at the moment of the event, which listed object is leftmost / rightmost from the wearer's viewpoint
skills.object_location_at_time: L1: on which surface / fixture / container an object is put down at the event
skills.object_grounding: L1: localise the object of the event in a frame (bounding box)
skills.action_recognition: L2: what action (verb + object) the event is
skills.event_object_role: L2: which object is acted on, with which tool, to which destination in the event
skills.action_temporal_order: L2: the order of two actions shown close together inside one sub-goal
skills.sound_action_binding: L2: which action / object produced the sound heard
skills.object_state_change: L2: where an object was taken from and where it went in one movement
skills.sound_movement_binding: L2: which object movement coincides with the sound
skills.sound_anchored_spatial_near: L2: at the moment of a sound, which listed object is nearest to a reference object
skills.sound_anchored_spatial_side: L2: at the moment of a sound, which listed object is leftmost / rightmost for the wearer

l3_relation_types.object_continuity: the same object / ingredient appears in an event of sub-goal k and an event of the ADJACENT sub-goal k+1; what happened to it between them (chopped broccoli -> in the pan)
l3_relation_types.state_change: how the state of an object differs between the two events (whole -> chopped, empty -> full, raw -> browned)
l3_relation_types.causal_prerequisite: the earlier event is a physical prerequisite of the later one (could not be done without it)
l3_relation_types.hidden_state: an appliance / container state was set in the earlier event and is not visible in the later segment; what is its state at the end of the later segment
l3_relation_types.spatial_end_state: after placements in the two events, which listed object ends nearest / farthest to a reference object (needs 3D records)

plan.goal: Build the wraps: On a tortilla wrap, add shredded lettuce, chopped tomatoes, chopped onion, spicy chicken and creamy hot sauce, then wrap into a burrito shaped roll or whatever shape desired.

events.description: Various ingredients are placed onto the kitchen counter.
events.relevance: brings the necessary components into the workspace

events.description: The plastic bag containing lettuce is torn open.
A crinkling sound is made by the plastic bag being manipulated.
events.relevance: indicates the bag is being opened

events.description: A handful of lettuce is pulled out of the bag.
events.relevance: extracts the ingredient needed for the wrap

events.description: The outer skin is peeled off the onion.
events.relevance: removes the inedible part of the onion

events.description: The knife slices the peeled onion into two halves.
events.relevance: prepares the onion for fine chopping

events.description: The knife rapidly cuts the onion halves into fine pieces.
events.relevance: processes the onion to the required size for the wrap

events.description: A rapid tapping sound is heard as the knife hits the board.
events.relevance: indicates the chopping action is occurring

events.description: The chopped onion pieces are scooped up and dropped into a bowl.
events.relevance: stores the prepared ingredient for later assembly

events.description: A chopping board is set down on the workspace.
events.relevance: provides a surface for cutting the tomato

events.description: A whole tomato is placed onto a digital scale.
The knife slices into the first tomato.
events.relevance: opens the tomato to access the seeds

events.description: The inner seeds are scraped out of the tomato halves.
The deseeded tomato is cut into small diced pieces.
events.relevance: processes the tomato to the required size for the wrap

events.description: The knife slices into the second tomato.
events.relevance: opens the second tomato to access the seeds

events.description: The seeds are removed from the second tomato.
The second deseeded tomato is cut into small diced pieces.
events.relevance: processes the second tomato to the required size for the wrap

relations.ask: What state was the onion in immediately before it was finely chopped?
relations.answer_hint: The earlier event cut the peeled onion into two halves.

relations.ask: What is the state of the ingredient being transferred into the bowl?
relations.answer_hint: The onion was just finely chopped in the previous step.

relations.ask: Which tomato is being cut into?
relations.answer_hint: The tomato that was just weighed on the scale.

relations.ask: What part of the tomato is missing when it is being chopped?
relations.answer_hint: The seeds were scraped out in the previous step.

relations.ask: What part of the second tomato is missing when it is being chopped?
relations.answer_hint: The seeds were removed in the previous step.

decision_points.why: Moving from general organization to preparing the first specific ingredient (lettuce).
Switching focus from the lettuce to a new ingredient, the onion.
Chopping is the immediate logical next step after peeling and halving the onion.
Transferring the chopped ingredient to a bowl is a standard cleanup and prep completion step.
Switching focus from the onion to preparing the workspace for a new ingredient, the tomato.
Removing seeds is a natural preparation step after weighing the tomato.
Chopping immediately follows the deseeding process for the tomato.
Deciding to prepare a second tomato rather than moving on to the next ingredient.
Chopping immediately follows the deseeding process for the second tomato.
All ingredient preparation is complete, and the decision is made to transition to the actual assembly of the wraps.
